title: Interest rate dilemma for central banks as inflation rises but growth slows

paragraphs.en: As the Middle East crisis drags on into its sixth month, central banks sit in a tricky position. Oil prices remain at elevated levels, stoking inflationary pressures while also threatening to weigh on growth.
paragraphs.zh: 随着中东危机拖入第六个月，各央行处境棘手。油价仍处于高位，在加剧通胀压力的同时，也可能拖累经济增长。

paragraphs.en: The US Federal Reserve, the Bank of England and the European Central Bank are still smarting from the criticism of their inaction in 2022, when inflation soared above 10% in the UK and eurozone and over 9% in the US.
paragraphs.zh: 美联储（US Federal Reserve）、英国央行（Bank of England）和欧洲央行（European Central Bank）仍对2022年因无所作为而受到的批评耿耿于怀——当年英国和欧元区通胀飙升至10%以上，美国通胀也超过9%。

paragraphs.en: Central banks were plagued by accusations that they moved too slowly to confront inflation in the months after the Ukraine war started, when post-pandemic consumer spending was already stoking prices on everything from food to construction materials.
paragraphs.zh: 在乌克兰战争爆发后的几个月里，央行饱受指责，称其在应对通胀方面行动太慢。当时，疫后消费支出已在推高从食品到建筑材料等各种商品的价格。

paragraphs.en: Related: Trump Fed chair’s inflation strategy: leave it to the market | Eduardo Porter
paragraphs.zh: 相关阅读：特朗普任命的联储主席的通胀策略：交给市场｜爱德华多·波特（Eduardo Porter）

paragraphs.en: Now they are asking whether the continuing throttling of fossil fuel shipping through the strait of Hormuz will mean another year of target-busting prices growth.
paragraphs.zh: 如今，他们正在考虑，通过霍尔木兹海峡的化石燃料运输持续受阻，是否意味着又将迎来一年超出目标水平的物价上涨。

paragraphs.en: Last month US inflation edged lower to 3.4%, down from 3.5% in June and 4.2% in May, largely in response to easing petrol prices following the US memorandum of understanding with Iran.
paragraphs.zh: 上个月，美国通胀小幅回落至3.4%，低于6月的3.5%和5月的4.2%，这主要得益于美国与伊朗达成谅解备忘录后汽油价格回落。

paragraphs.en: Since the Bureau of Labor Statistics collected the data, the price of a barrel of Brent crude has risen again to about $90 – a figure that will push up the price of energy and transport across the US in the second half of the year.
paragraphs.zh: 自美国劳工统计局（Bureau of Labor Statistics）收集上述数据以来，布伦特原油价格已再度升至每桶约90美元——这一价位将在今年下半年推高全美能源和运输价格。

paragraphs.en: Fed officials are asking whether US inflation will climb back towards 4%, double its target. The US central bank’s new boss, Kevin Warsh, has instigated an all-embracing review of its operations based on the advice of 15 outsiders that he says are among the most eminent experts and economists of the age.
paragraphs.zh: 美联储官员正在思考，美国通胀是否会重新攀升至4%左右，达到其目标的两倍。美国央行的新任掌门人凯文·沃什（Kevin Warsh）已根据15位外部人士的建议，对其运作展开全面评估。他说，这些人堪称当代最杰出的专家和经济学家。
